title: MineDojo benchmark and knowledge base
content_excerpt: MineDojo is a research framework with thousands of Minecraft tasks and an internet-scale knowledge base including YouTube videos, Wiki pages, and Reddit posts.
evidence_notes: Reference for task definitions, success criteria, and how community knowledge can be organized for embodied agents.
related_game_versions: Java Edition versions used by the benchmark
